takeover.Name: Vesper plays ambient sounds
takeover.Hint: Ambient sounds placed with Foundry's tools are played by Vesper (direction, walls, reverb). Unchecked: Foundry plays them as usual. Each sound can also be handed back to Foundry in its sheet.

realism.Name: Distance falloff realism
realism.Hint: 1: physical law (drops fast near the source, then slowly, like in real life). 0: linear to the edge, like Foundry.

airAbsorption.Name: Air absorption
airAbsorption.Hint: Distant sounds lose their highs and sound duller.

wallLoss.Name: Solid wall (dB)
wallLoss.Hint: Volume lost through a wall that blocks sound. Highs are strongly reduced too.

doorLoss.Name: Closed door (dB)
doorLoss.Hint: Loss through a closed door (an open door lets everything through).

thinLoss.Name: Limited wall (dB)
thinLoss.Hint: Loss through a wall that is « limited » for sound: curtain, fence, partition.

defaultPlace.Name: Default acoustic place
defaultPlace.Hint: Reverb outside « Acoustics » Regions for scenes that don't choose one (set per scene in the soundscape).

gmListener.Name: GM listening without a token
gmListener.Hint: When the GM controls no token.
gmListener.Camera: From the center of the screen

panning.Name: Spatialization
panning.Hint: HRTF: 3D sound on headphones (recommended). Stereo: simple left/right, lighter. Off: all sounds centered.

occlusionQuality.Name: Wall precision
occlusionQuality.Hint: Precise: five rays per sound, sound leaks through openings. Fast: a single ray.

masterVolume.Name: Vesper volume
masterVolume.Hint: Applied on top of Foundry's « Ambient » slider.

reverbVolume.Name: Reverb volume
reverbVolume.Hint: 1 = the level the place calls for.

soundscape.Name: Soundscape
soundscape.Hint: Uncheck to stop hearing ambience layers (on this computer).

place.label: Acoustic place
place.hint: The reverb you hear while standing in the Region.

wet.label: Reverb level
wet.hint: Empty: recommended level for this place.

isolation.label: Isolation
isolation.hint: 0: open. 1: tightly closed. Sounds from one side heard on the other are muffled, even without walls, and « outdoor » ambience layers become dull inside.

Soundscape.Title: Soundscape — {scene}
Soundscape.DefaultPlaceHint: Reverb outside « Acoustics » Regions. For a room, a cave, a tavern: add the « Acoustics (Vesper) » behavior to a Region.
Soundscape.Empty: No layers. Add a loop, scattered sounds, a generated layer, or start from a template.

Layer.OutdoorHint: Muffled when entering an isolated Region (the storm from inside the tavern).

Synth.windHint: Follows Ember's wind strength if active, otherwise blows softly and grows with tension.
Synth.rainHint: Follows Ember's rain intensity if active.
Synth.droneHint: Low and slow, more and more dissonant with tension.
Synth.heartbeatHint: Speeds up with tension (58 to 120 beats per minute).

Template.Added: Layers added: pick their files (generated layers already play).

SoundConfig.ManagedHint: Direction, walls and reverb. Unchecked: Foundry plays this sound as usual.
SoundConfig.DirectionalHint: The sound comes from one side. Unchecked: a bed with no direction (rain over the whole area).
SoundConfig.SizeHint: A river, a crowd, a waterfall are large: they fade more slowly and sound wider.

Error.GMOnly: Only the GM can change the soundscape.

Log.NoEmber: Ember is not active: layer weather conditions assume clear weather.
